title: Rainbow River Scenic Eco Cruise with Optional Snorkeling
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Explore the stunning Rainbow River on a small-group sightseeing and snorkel cruise, where crystal-clear waters and lush Florida scenery come alive. Choose from peaceful morning or golden afternoon departures and enjoy the option to snorkel among fish, turtles, and aquatic plants—or simply relax on deck and take in the views. With a maximum of 6 guests, this eco-friendly cruise offers a personal and family-friendly way to experience one of Florida’s most beautiful spring-fed rivers.
